# Call Subroutine

Source: [wiki article 6041](../archive/6041.md); edited 2025-05-24.

Exact pinned API: [Call Subroutine](../../api/actions/call-subroutine.md).

<a id="wiki-6041-n1"></a>

- Call Subroutine pauses the caller, resumes it after the subroutine finishes, and gives the callee the caller's event context such as Event Player.

<a id="wiki-6041-n2"></a>

- If no rule declares the requested subroutine, the action is ignored.

<a id="wiki-6041-n3"></a>

- Reusing a subroutine can reduce Workshop element count; nested calls are illustrated.
